trigger_condition: CLI keeps revealing new model options on every arrow-down with no repeat step
guard_snippet: if (steps > MAX_MODEL_PAGINATION_STEPS) throw { step: 'model', message: 'pagination did not settle' };
potential_consequence: collectModelOptions loops forever, run never settles or times out

trigger_condition: live PTY redraw during the model pagination walk re-detects a 'model' prompt with different visible options
guard_snippet: skip re-dispatch while a model-pagination walk is in flight (a modelWalkInProgress flag) instead of relying on signature diff
potential_consequence: second concurrent handleDetectedPrompt('model') call races collectModelOptions, corrupting arrow-key writes/cursor position

trigger_condition: kill() rejects (e.g. pty_kill invoke fails) while !exited during cleanup
potential_consequence: resumePtyInput() is skipped, terminal keystroke forwarding stays suspended for the rest of the session

trigger_condition: PTY byte chunk is not valid base64, atob throws
guard_snippet: on decode failure, surface/settleReject instead of writing the raw base64 text as terminal bytes
potential_consequence: garbled base64 string written into the xterm buffer, silently corrupting subsequent prompt detection with no error surfaced

trigger_condition: onPromptCb returns an index not present in filtered (e.g. out of range)
guard_snippet: if (rawIndex === -1) throw { step: 'model', message: 'invalid model selection index' };
potential_consequence: raw.indexOf returns -1, driver silently moves the cursor to the wrong menu entry instead of erroring

trigger_condition: screen goes idle showing a prompt detectPrompt can't classify and without a trailing (y/N) hint
guard_snippet: on idle timeout with no YN_HINT match, settleReject({step:null, message:'unrecognized idle prompt', raw: lines.join("\n")})
potential_consequence: driver hangs indefinitely with no timeout or error, since no further onData ever reschedules the idle check

trigger_condition: generic fallback prompt kind and onPromptCb returns a non-primitive answer (object/array)
guard_snippet: await innerDeps.input(typeof answer === 'string' ? ... : throw new Error('unsupported answer type'))
potential_consequence: String(answer) yields '[object Object]' written verbatim into the CLI's stdin

trigger_condition: detectPrompt ever reports an id present in AUTO_LIST/AUTO_CONFIRM but with a mismatched prompt.kind (e.g. CLI wording change)
guard_snippet: if (prompt.kind !== 'list') throw {...}; // before AUTO_LIST branch; same for AUTO_CONFIRM vs 'confirm'
potential_consequence: wrong key sequence (arrow/y-n) sent to a differently-shaped prompt, silently mis-answering it
